entities.summary: Kosovo is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Pristina. Official languages include Albanian, Serbian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 1.8 million. Area: 10,887 km². Comprehensive index for Kosovo covering Illyrian/Dardanian roots, Roman province of Dardania, medieval Serbian kingdom (Battle of Kosovo 1389 vs Ottomans, central to Serbian national mythology), Ottoman rule (1455-1912), Albanian majority consolidation, Balkan Wars 1912 (Serbian reconquest), Kingdom of Yugoslavia, WWII (Italian/German occupation), communist Yugoslavia (autonomous province), Milošević revocation of autonomy 1989, Kosovo War 1998-99 (NATO bombing, ethnic cleansing), UN administration (UNMIK), independence declared 2008, partial international recognition.
